name: AI Assistant
description: Chat with an AI model from the terminal. You choose the service (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama or your own address) and give your API key.

changelog.1.0.0: First release: asks which AI service to use and for your key, streams answers, keeps the conversation, saves it, works with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible address.
